spec.source: Clang 18.1.3, clang/lib/CodeGen/CGBuiltin.cpp, lowering of Builtin::BI__builtin_expect; LLVM 18.1.8 Language Reference, § llvm.expect Intrinsic (https://releases.llvm.org/18.1.8/docs/LangRef.html#llvm-expect-intrinsic). Delivered summary: background/4/builtin-references.md:5–8.

__builtin_expect.name: Clang ordinary two-operand branch expectation
__builtin_expect.requires: 在所述 Clang 配置、GNU C 源码调用中，第一实参可按原表达式的规则合法求值并转换为 long；第二实参提供转换为 long 的整数常量期望值。
__builtin_expect.ensures: 表达式的 long 结果等于实际求值得到的第一实参转换为 long 后的值。第二实参为优化提示；第一实参的实际值可以与期望值不同。第一实参求值原有的效果保留。

checks: 调用点按实际求得的第一实参分支，不从提示推导输入事实、返回值相等约束或特定机器分支布局。

review_reason: background/4/builtin-references.md:5–8 records the Clang 18.1.3 lowering reference and LLVM intrinsic authority for the ordinary long(long, long) operation. The contract preserves the actual converted first operand and its evaluation effects and treats the constant expectation only as a prediction hint. The registered call has the matching compiler profile and signature, and project/target/crypto/array_alloc.c:28–36 uses its result to test the multiplication outcome. The proposed checks neither impose equality with the expected operand nor promise a machine-code branch layout.
